'''2000 Decipher World Championship Yannick Lapointe THE MACHINE KILLA 2''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech after playing it at [[2000 Decipher World Championship]]. The post's description says: "the deck i use in day 3, 2-1 losing because of a meta choice:(" (2000 Decipher World Championship Day 3, 7 October 2000). Decipher's Deck Designs published his Worlds Light list: [[2000 Decipher World Championship Yannick Lapointe LS]].<ref name="dt-11042">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11042 THE MACHINE KILLA 2], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 10 October 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/11042/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/11042/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018110723/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/11042/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
